ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity to low-intensity pixels, estimated at approximately 0.05:0.95 across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly dark background. High-intensity white clusters are localized at the extreme left and right distal tips, with smaller scattered mottling in the interior lower-left region of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide U-shaped central depression with an approximate internal angle of 130 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire boundary; the right lobe trailing edge contains deeper, more irregular jagged interruptions compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: S-shaped trajectory exhibiting initial convexity from the notch transitioning to concavity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated circular high-contrast clusters at the outer tips of both lobes; several smaller circular clusters scattered across the ventral surface of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple low-contrast, unaligned linear pixel disruptions oriented diagonally across the lower half of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Substantial irregular indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe; significant white accumulations at both distal tips.
